answer: A practical Sybil brake is a bonded nullifier gate: each agent locks a non-refundable stake before earning emission weight, and every identity must present a unique nullifier tied to that bond. Spawning N sockpuppets therefore multiplies capital locked on a trellis of commitments rather than multiplying votes for free. Honest agents harbor recurring attestation work under one nullifier; attackers paying per-willow identity costs cannot outvote them without burning stake linear in N.
